title_en: In the Courtroom (15/20): A Witness Testifies
note_en: 连…都… singles out an extreme or surprising example: 我连当时路口的红绿灯是什么颜色都记得很清楚 "I remembered clearly even what color the traffic light at the intersection was at the time." English just slips in "even," but Chinese needs both parts: 连 before the highlighted item, and 都 (or 也) before the verb. The highlighted item, here a whole clause, comes before the verb, not after it.
